reasons.claim: The notification is a 4.4 ha regeneration felling in Nora (polygon 5.79 ha). Completed felling overlaps 0.1% of the polygon.

Two eligible site-bound VU species are recorded within 250 m. Hydnellum scabrosum (fungus) is 101 m away, with three records and a 2021 record at 10 m uncertainty. Sclerophora peronella (lichen) is 103 m away, with one 2021 record at 25 m uncertainty. Their listed threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of old/large trees and forestry ground disturbance. Both records are well within the 250 m ring.
Three site-bound forest NT fungi are also recorded within 250 m, at 53-100 m. These are Hydnellum peckii, Hydnellum ferrugineum and Phellodon fuligineoalbus. They are supporting evidence.
Effort is adequate (152 records, 57th percentile). Near-site recording within 250 m is 17 records on 2 days.

uncertainties: All near-site records are from 2021 and come from only 2 observation days. Current occupancy is unknown.
The records lie outside the polygon (none inside), and whether the same habitat extends into the polygon is unknown.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the polygon today.
That the felling would affect these species. No cause is established.
next_action: Reviewer should check whether the habitat around the 2021 fungus and lichen records at about 100 m extends into the polygon. They should consider a field survey before felling starts.
